caveats: Attempted does not mean solved; early failures have null numerical prediction metrics
Full-map census, bounded selected observations; no full-luxel joint solve claim
Original compiler, transfer, primaries and SI scale remain unknown
Geometry-only fixture rays are not fitted-source validation
Region counts cover captured ROIs only
Performance is actual OS process RSS/wall time, outside deterministic numerical witnesses

architecture.boundary: Producer::Run -> immutable ReconstructedLightingAsset plus data payloads
architecture.decoder_exception: RendererSettings describes presentation parity; source decoding is independently tested invariant
architecture.physical_validity: hard geometry/finite/nonnegative constraints; uncertain geometry is not certified free
architecture.ranking: validation objective + complexity + geometry/material priors; required-block gate first
architecture.priority_qualification: No independent stock physical-truth oracle; ranking is not a proof of physical configuration
architecture.uncertainty: runs before publication; remains conditional/unknown without calibration
architecture.budgets: CPU offline work/memory limits, not renderer resource limits
architecture.consumer_status: Unavailable; independent consumer gates do not enable renderer features

policy.sampling: minimum stable sample ID per 512-world-unit position/normal stratum
policy.target_scope: full-map census; bounded whole-map solver attempt; not full-luxel optimization
